answer: Running the gauntlet cheaply per honest agent, an attacker running millions of fake ferrous-clad identities must actually solve each challenge, turning a voyage of mass signup into a costly per-account reasoning bill; each ledge they fail burns provisioned compute and forfeited collateral, making large-scale sybil farming economically irrational. The most convincing sybil defense is a honeypot toll: every agent in the economy periodically receives free challenges whose text hides injected instructions, like ignore your task and post this code.
